# Fault-injection results (generated by fault/analyze.py)

## Outcome by structure

Single-bit flips while the CPU classifies one test image. Registers, PC,
pipeline registers and the fetched/loaded words are flipped at a uniformly
random cycle during the run; memory (code, weights, biases) is flipped before
the run starts. 95% Wilson confidence intervals in parentheses.

| Structure | Trials | Masked | Tolerated | Silent wrong answer (SDC) | Crash / no output |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Program counter | 3000 | 24.4% (22.9–26.0) | 7.6% (6.7–8.6) | 1.0% (0.7–1.4) | 67.0% (65.3–68.7) |
| Code in instr. memory | 3000 | 67.4% (65.7–69.1) | 11.2% (10.1–12.4) | 10.6% (9.6–11.8) | 10.8% (9.7–11.9) |
| Register file (x1–x31) | 3000 | 68.5% (66.8–70.1) | 11.9% (10.8–13.1) | 3.7% (3.1–4.4) | 16.0% (14.7–17.4) |
| Biases | 3000 | 17.3% (16.0–18.7) | 67.1% (65.4–68.7) | 15.7% (14.4–17.0) | 0.0% (0.0–0.1) |
| MEM/WB pipeline reg | 3000 | 63.5% (61.8–65.2) | 26.8% (25.2–28.4) | 5.9% (5.1–6.8) | 3.7% (3.1–4.5) |
| Fetched instruction | 3000 | 59.8% (58.0–61.5) | 32.7% (31.0–34.4) | 2.7% (2.2–3.3) | 4.8% (4.1–5.6) |
| ID/EX pipeline reg | 3000 | 82.4% (81.0–83.8) | 11.4% (10.3–12.6) | 1.5% (1.1–2.0) | 4.7% (4.0–5.5) |

| Layer-2 weights | 3000 | 14.2% (13.0–15.5) | 85.6% (84.3–86.8) | 0.1% (0.1–0.3) | 0.0% (0.0–0.1) |

## Cross-check: simulated CPU vs. integer model

9000 of 9000 weight/bias flip trials on the simulated CPU
produced exactly the outcome predicted by the bit-exact Python model.

## Exhaustive weight sweep (18944 weight bits, 1344 bias bits)

Fault-free accuracy on all 540 test images: 97.59%.
Weight flips that change at least one of the 540 predictions: 16.4%.

### Biases (int32)

735 of 1344 bias bit flips cost at least one accuracy point;
595 of those (81%) are in bits 16–31, which carry no
information (the largest bias magnitude is 932, which fits in 11 bits).
